card.name: Just before a share or percentage figure
card.fires_on: The space or word right before a number giving a share of a group, usually a percent, in lists of proportions or group comparisons. It also fires at a few partitive spots like 'the top half' or 'accounting for'.

modes.label: Before a percentage
modes.description: The blank space or opening bracket just before a percent or count in a comparison of groups.

modes.label: Verb before a share
modes.description: A word like accounting or captured that leads into a percent of a total.
modes.example: with Hispanics<< accounting>> for 11% of the total

modes.label: Part of a whole
modes.description: A noun or word inside a phrase about one part of a set, such as half a deck.
modes.example: Have him slip his<< card>> into the deck wherever he wants.

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning part, half, subset and fraction, so it makes such part-of-whole words less likely next.
card.plain: It marks the point where a share of a group is about to be given as a number, like a percent.
